manifest=json.loads((new/'WEB_BUILD_MANIFEST.json').read_text());old=json.loads((dest/'WEB_BUILD_MANIFEST.json').read_text())
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

newassets={x['original']:x['original_sha256'] for x in manifest['assets']}
for item in old['assets']:assert newassets[item['original']]==item['original_sha256'],item['original']

for p in new.rglob('*'):
 if p.is_file():assert sha(p)==sha(dest/p.relative_to(new))
